findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Use the trailing-slash endpoint `https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/` in both .mcp.json and .codex/config.toml to match the existing configs and the nginx `/mcp/` edge (or explicitly confirm the slash-less form routes).

docs/mcp-client-setup.md lines 74, 95, 114, 136 and docs/mcp-auth.md line 322-323 all use '/mcp/'

findings.finding: The Codex (and Copilot .mcp.json) URL in the plan is written as https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp WITHOUT the trailing slash, whereas every existing repo config, example, and doc uses /mcp/ WITH a trailing slash behind the nginx `/mcp/` TLS edge. A trailing-slash mismatch against an nginx location can cause a routing failure or redirect.
scenarios: Codex/Copilot connect to /mcp (no slash), nginx returns a redirect or 404 the client does not follow, and the MCP handshake fails
findings.suggested_fix: Write the url as https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/ in both new config files.
